subject: HarborPay: request for IRP, sanitized logs, and post-incident artifacts
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah@harborpay.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@harborpay.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspicious activity noticed — request for IRP and logs

Hi Neha,

Quick note from HarborPay security — we detected unusual token usage for our integration with Redwood between 2026-07-31 22:40 UTC and 2026-08-01 01:05 UTC. We’ve rate-limited the integration on our side and are continuing investigation, but we need a few things from Redwood for our SOC 2 / SIG audit:

- Your current Incident Response Plan (IRP) that would apply to a third-party-facing token/session issue
- A redacted sample of server-side request logs and the KV/prefix cache access logs for the affected timeframe (we can take a sanitized CSV)
- Any post-incident summary / timeline you can share now and a target date for a full postmortem

We understand there may be redaction requirements — we’re fine with sanitized extracts. Procurement is looped for tracking (they may also request an expedited delivery and certificate of authenticity for audit).

Please let us know the earliest you can share the IRP and a sample log extract. If helpful, Nicole from SecureAudit (copied below) will accept secure transfer and validate redactions for our SIG/CAIQ mapping.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Sr. Security Operations
HarborPay

Attachment: screenshot-alert.png (image/PNG)
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sarah Li <sarah@harborpay.com>, procurement@harborpay.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Suspicious activity noticed — request for IRP and logs

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and sorry you ran into this. We’re treating this as high priority.

Short plan (next 24 hours):
1) I’ll attach our IRP v3.4 and a redaction guidance doc for your audit team now.
2) Marissa (Security) will prepare a redacted log sample covering the timeframe you listed and a short chain-of-custody note.
3) Jonas (Ops) will confirm whether any running jobs or keys were rotated and provide timestamps.
4) We’ll prepare a brief interim timeline (what we know immediately) and follow with a full postmortem within 72 hours unless we hit blockers.

Delivery options: secure SFTP or SecureAudit (Nicole) is fine — whichever HarborPay prefers. Please confirm preferred transfer method and whether you need HSM-signed evidence.

I’m attaching the IRP and will follow up once the log extract is ready.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: IRP_v3.4.pdf (application/pdf)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah@harborpay.com>, Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@secureaudit.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Suspicious activity noticed — preparing sanitized artifacts

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 11:03 AM neha.kapoor@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and sorry you ran into this. We’re treating this as high priority.
>
> Short plan (next 24 hours):
> 1) I’ll attach our IRP v3.4 and a redaction guidance doc for your audit team now.
>
Thanks Neha — I’ll start the extraction. Two clarifying asks for HarborPay:

- Scope: Are we limiting to API keys associated with HarborPay's account only, or do you want a cross-tenant sampling window? (I recommend the HarborPay-scoped extract only.)
- Redaction: HarborPay requested 'sanitized CSV' — I will remove full session tokens and IPs and keep hashed identifiers. If HarborPay needs additional redaction (e.g., user email redaction or noise injection), please confirm.

Ops note for Jonas: I’ll need the KV cache read logs and the request->response latency traces for the period Sarah specified. I’ll prepare a chain-of-custody note and sign it. ETA: 5 hours for initial sample, 36 hours for more exhaustive traces.

-Marissa
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redaction_guidance.txt (text/plain)
From: Sarah Li <sarah@harborpay.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@harborpay.com, Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@secureaudit.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspicious activity noticed — request for IRP and logs

Thanks — HarborPay confirms: scope should be HarborPay-associated API keys only. Transfer via SecureAudit (Nicole) is preferred. We do request an expedited delivery (procurement is asking for formal evidence for our auditor). HSM-signed chain-of-custody would be ideal but not a blocker for the initial sample.

We appreciate the 5-hour ETA for the initial sample. Please copy procurement on the transfer ticket so they can attach it to the audit binder.

—Sarah

Attachment: none
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sarah Li <sarah@harborpay.com>, Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@secureaudit.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, procurement@harborpay.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 18:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Suspicious activity noticed — interim post-incident artifacts and next steps

Sarah / Nicole — quick update and deliverables (interim):

1) Attached: redacted_postmortem_20260802.pdf — an interim timeline and root-cause hypothesis (redacted for customer PII).
2) Attached: harborpay_forensic_sample_redacted.csv — includes request_id, timestamp, hashed_key_id, action_type, and status. IPs and raw tokens removed per redaction guidance.
3) Attached: IRP_v3.4.pdf (previously shared) — our canonical incident response plan; section 4 covers third-party evidence handling and retention.

Chain-of-custody: I’ve included a signed manifest in the Drive link and we used SecureAudit SFTP for the transfer. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-ExampleDriveLink

Next steps:
- Marissa will follow up with the full traces and a signed chain-of-custody within 36 hours.
- Jonas will confirm whether any keys were rotated (if so we will provide rotation timestamps and affected job ids).
- We’ll produce a final postmortem within 72 hours. If HarborPay’s auditor needs additional specific fields in the sample CSV, please list them and we’ll include in the final delivery.

If you need HSM-signed artifacts for procurement, we can request an exception and accelerate that for an evidence fee — say if procurement needs it for certificate purposes.

Thanks for coordinating.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_postmortem_20260802.pdf, harborpay_forensic_sample_redacted.csv, IRP_v3.4.pdf
